prep: no prep/ directory and no prep.done for this slug; plan, audits and comparator reading built by the writer

inherited.M01: Copy-typing sentence data from one participant (T5), 242 pilot sentences then cumulative daily data (572 sentences by the last day); BrainGate data-collection lineage
inherited.M03: Daily supervised recalibration (50 sentences per day), BrainGate intracortical-BCI lineage; reduced-calibration and unsupervised-retraining results are offline simulations
inherited.M05: Two microelectrode arrays in hand-knob precentral gyrus (BrainGate)
inherited.M09: Characters shown on screen as detected; no confirmation step
inherited.M10: No backspace or editing; participant told to keep writing after errors
inherited.M11: Prompted sentences as reference for copy typing; free-typing reference construction not described
inherited.M13: Single participant, percutaneous implant, daily recalibration; authors call it a proof of concept

topics.inclusion_rule: Neural BCI studies (intracortical, ECoG, sEEG, EEG, MEG) whose ledger names the recording modality together with a text output, a text error rate or a text-entry rate (characters or words per minute); the design compared is the user action that drives text at use time (attempted handwriting, attempted or overt speech, imagined or inner speech, cursor or keyboard selection, evoked-potential spelling, speech perception). Boundary: a study counts under every action its full text names (upper bound, related-work mentions included); reviews count as pattern matches; versions counted once.
topics.pattern: ledger modality (ecog|intracortical|utah|microelectrode|seeg|eeg|meg) AND (WER|CER|text decoding|brain-to-text|characters per minute|words per minute|typing rate|text entry|bits per second)
topics.design_field: M04 production_labels (slot-filled) and full-text regexes attempted_handwriting, attempted_speech, overt_speech, imagined_or_inner_speech, cursor_keyboard_typing, speech_perception, evoked_potential_speller
topics.metric: characters per minute (higher better); CER where reported

topics.inclusion_rule: The same 154-study neural text-entry population, classified by how the decoder obtains per-time-step targets for sentence data when the intended output has no observable timing: alignment-free CTC loss, HMM or forced alignment, labels aligned to simultaneously recorded audio or speech onset, time warping, synthetic neural data augmentation, attention sequence-to-sequence. Boundary: a study counts under every design its full text names (upper bound); M03 supervision_kind gives the slot-filled values because M02 is sparse.
topics.design_field: --design-slot M03 --design-field supervision_kind; full-text regexes ctc_alignment_free, hmm_forced_alignment, audio_or_onset_aligned_labels, time_warping, synthetic_neural_data_augmentation, seq2seq_attention
topics.metric: online WER or CER of the trained decoder

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table (inclusion rule kept as published): recurrent or CTC-trained decoders emitting phoneme or character probabilities converted to words with a language model.
Reused published table: neural decoders constraining output with a vocabulary of at least 1,000 words via an n-gram or neural language model.
Reused published table: whether reported WER is measured on sentences absent from training or on repeats of training sentences.
